decision.question: Qual é o escopo normativo do MVP que será efetivamente aceito?
decision.rationale: O pacote de escopo já formaliza um conjunto coerente para a primeira operação comercial real e separa explicitamente capacidades pós-MVP. A aprovação não promove implementação existente a requisito nem autoriza automaticamente schema, merge ou produção.
decision.affected_requirements: Customer; Conversation; Message; Inbox/InboundInbox; AI/Conversation+LLM; Product; Order; Inventory; Pricing; Freight; Sale; DomainOutbox; Recovery; WhatsApp; Human Handoff; Windows Runtime.
decision.affected_contracts: Customer Identity; Conversation; Message; DomainOutbox; downstream IA-02/IA-03 contracts.
decision.affected_schema: Schema must represent only the approved MVP after IA-01 reconciliation; existing physical artifacts are not retroactively authorized.
decision.explicit_non_scope: Image; Audio; PDF Import; Campaign; Advanced Attribution; Advanced KPI; Multi-provider LLM; cross-channel identity stitching; complex promotion engine; complex freight integrations; SaaS billing; automatic schema/migration authorization; merge; production release.
decision.evidence: consensus/governance/MVP_SCOPE_DECISION.md; current MVP2 HEAD e2d8807a6e797b0fb35e6a4658f8c4aabec7535a; prior governance reconciliation.

decision.question: Qual é o status normativo da Migration 0002 existente fisicamente no MVP2?
decision.rationale: A migration física existente não corresponde integralmente à projeção canônica, contradiz o gate documental anterior e não pode ser promovida por mera existência física. Preservar sua evidência histórica sem autoridade normativa reduz o risco de cristalizar um schema parcial como baseline.
decision.affected_requirements: Migration governance; canonical schema consistency; release gate.
decision.affected_contracts: Schema authority; Product/Order persistence; DomainOutbox-dependent persistence.
decision.affected_schema: apps/desktop/database/migrations/0002_c1_product_order.sql remains physically present but non-authoritative. No removal, rename, replacement or execution is authorized by this decision.
decision.explicit_non_scope: Deletion of 0002; new migration creation; migration execution; schema replacement; merge.
decision.evidence: apps/desktop/database/migrations/0002_c1_product_order.sql exists in MVP2; agents/01-schema/MIGRATION-0002-PROJECTION.md says 0002 is not created; agents/01-schema/HUMAN-SCHEMA-REVIEW.md says 0002 is not authorized; consensus/governance/MVP2-RECONCILIATION.md classifies the conflict as governance drift.

decision.question: Qual é a identidade canônica de Customer para o MVP?
decision.rationale: O modelo preserva isolamento por store, fornece identidade determinística para o canal WhatsApp do MVP e evita introduzir identity graph ou merge automático não necessários ao primeiro escopo.
decision.affected_requirements: Customer canonical identity; WhatsApp identity resolution.
decision.affected_contracts: Customer Identity Contract; Transport Identity -> Identity Resolution -> Customer.
decision.affected_schema: UNIQUE(store_id, phone_normalized) for canonical Customer identity.
decision.explicit_non_scope: Cross-channel identity stitching; automatic customer merging; identity graph.

decision.question: Qual é a cardinalidade e identidade canônica de Conversation?
decision.rationale: Uma Conversation pertence a um Customer, pode haver múltiplas conversas por Customer e o identificador interno do domínio deve permanecer distinto do identificador do transporte externo. Store scoping fornece determinismo sem introduzir cross-channel stitching.
decision.affected_schema: UNIQUE(store_id, external_thread_id); Conversation.id is distinct from external_thread_id.
decision.explicit_non_scope: Cross-channel conversation merge; automatic conversation stitching; multi-channel identity graph.

decision.question: Qual é a regra canônica de identidade/idempotência de Message?
decision.rationale: O invariável necessário para o MVP de ingestão é deduplicar mensagens externas de provider por store. Aplicar a mesma chave indistintamente a outbound poderia congelar uma semântica não demonstrada pelo evidence set atual. O outbound permanece explicitamente fora desta decisão e exigirá contrato próprio antes de congelar sua identidade.
decision.affected_schema: UNIQUE(store_id, external_message_id) for inbound provider messages; outbound identity is not frozen by this decision.
decision.explicit_non_scope: Canonical outbound message identity; provider-specific outbound correlation; cross-channel message stitching.
decision.evidence: docs/domain/entities.md; consensus/governance/CUSTOMER-CONVERSATION-MESSAGE-DECISION-PACKAGE.md; current mandate's inbound idempotency requirement.

decision.question: Qual é a ownership, scope e fronteira transacional normativa do DomainOutbox?
decision.rationale: Preserva separação semântica: domínio define intent/event semantics; IA-03 controla durable delivery mechanics e worker. A transação de negócio e o outbox intent devem compartilhar a mesma boundary quando ambos fazem parte da mesma operação persistente. Provider invocation ocorre somente após durable intent.
decision.affected_requirements: Atomic business state + outbox intent; durable delivery; idempotency; deterministic recovery; auditability.
decision.affected_contracts: Domain event contract; DomainOutbox; IA-03 delivery worker; provider boundary.
decision.affected_schema: DomainOutbox physical representation must be reconciled by IA-01 after this semantic decision; no migration change is authorized by this record.
decision.explicit_non_scope: Direct provider call after business persistence; hidden bypass paths; provider-owned business transaction semantics; schema implementation in this mandate.
decision.evidence: agents/02-domain/DOMAIN-GLOBAL-DECISIONS.md DREQ-004; consensus/governance/CONTRACT-001-DECISION-PACKAGE.md; required semantics documented in the Operator mandate.

global_invariants.item: Candidate recommendations are not authoritative; these decisions are normative because they are recorded by OPERATOR_PROJECT_GOVERNANCE.
Physical existence never implies normative authorization.
No decision in this record authorizes migration execution, schema mutation, merge or production release.
IA-01 must reconcile documentation/schema to these decisions without changing their normative content.
